purpose: Studio esplorativo movimento-arretramento-ripresa; nessuna strategia o valutazione economica

population.movementSource: FIB_SEQUENCE APPEND/REPLACE, non-degenerate alternating pair, causal availability
population.retireOn: new version of same direction, segment reset, or study end
population.repeatRearm: new counter close strictly after preceding attempt of this group
population.trigger: LONG Ck>Hprev and Ck>Ok; SHORT Ck<Lprev and Ck<Ok
population.primary: ordinal 1 of movement group, origin within DEV; subsequent attempts retained and linked
population.stateBeforeStudy: causal contexts and ordinals continued from initialization; no initialization origins in study

outcomes.markerUse: symmetric descriptive displacement, never stop/target, no costs or fills
outcomes.eventOrder: first minute contacts; open outside a marker orders same-minute contacts, otherwise BOTH_UNORDERED
outcomes.missing: complete-window outcomes null; observed prefix explicitly partial

jointContext.concordant: structure in direction, ordered SMA in direction, slope in direction (strict >0)
jointContext.opposite: structure opposite, ordered SMA opposite, slope opposite (strict <0)
jointContext.discordant: all required inputs available; every other combination, including zero or MIXED
jointContext.unavailable: one or more required inputs missing

families.levels: all causally available pivot/day levels and signed distances / A
families.volume: existing relative volume ratio, no bins
families.fibonacci: actual current anchors/version/r/u and distances; direction and availability explicit

summaries.main: jointContext within each movement direction on primary attempts
summaries.secondary: all linked attempts, labelled dependent, same fixed summaries

examples.rule: current_task OBS-002 section 6, fixed before extraction
